results.name: Agnes Banks Nature Reserve
results.description: Created in March 1982, this 123-hectare reserve protects part of the critically endangered Cumberland Plain Woodland. It is one of the few places in the world where the endangered nodding geebung, a shrub with yellow trumpet-like flowers, survives.
